_meta.description: AGG_DISTINCT_SUM on repeated_measures.pulse, where every subject contributes one row per condition: params.distinct_by subject_id sums the metric once per subject (the first value seen for a subject wins), against a plain AGG_SUM over all three rows per subject. AGG_DISTINCT_COUNT on the same key gives the subject count, the figure AGG_DISTINCT_SUM also reports as its distinct_count component.
_meta.name: distinct_sum_per_subject
